shared_preload_libraries.description: Comma-separated list of shared libraries to preload at server start. Must include 'postgis' for PostGIS functionality.

schema_search_path.description: Schema search path. 'postgis' should appear first so spatial functions like ST_GeomFromText are resolved unqualified.

work_mem.description: Amount of memory to use per operation for internal spatial computations (e.g., GEOS, buffer, intersection). Higher values improve performance for complex spatial joins, but increase total memory usage.

max_parallel_workers_per_gather.description: Maximum number of parallel workers per Gather node. Enables faster parallel scans and operations on large spatial tables (requires PostgreSQL 14+).

temp_directory.description: Directory used for temporary files during complex spatial operations (e.g., raster reprojection, large polygon unions). Ensure it exists and has write permissions for the PostgreSQL user.

log_min_messages.description: Minimum message level logged. Set to 'INFO' or 'LOG' only if debugging PostGIS functions, as spatial operations may generate many notices.
